text_block_list.text:
"It was late February. Under the cold skies,
the days of running toward the Yayoi Sho continued."
Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... ngh!
Phew... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, that's an incredible number of tires...
choice_data_list: Looks like you've been working hard.
Seems like you've been working hard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Lately, I've been going for runs in the morning too...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Why to that extent...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Suzuka-san!
Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, after training today,
would you mind running with me!?
The match race held between the two after training was—

—Special Week showed real guts in her chase,
but Silence Suzuka pulled off an overwhelming victory
with a wire-to-wire run, looking totally unfazed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I'm still not doing enough.
I've gotta try much harder...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...
Hey, Spe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh, Spe-chan's doing a tandem run again?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sei-chan.
Yeah, just a little. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "See you again"...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She's been doing it with someone every day lately~.
Even after training, she works so hard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Keep it in moderation, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks for caring. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Suzuka-san, one more lap—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Kya!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Are you all right...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...
All the strength just left my body.
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No, no, not at all!
choice_data_list: Taking a moderate break is necessary once in a while.
Taking a moderate break is necessary once in a while, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
I'm sorry for making you worry...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan,
why do you work so hard?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I worked hard at training, and after training, and in the morning, I kept running...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She was trying so hard,
to the point of staggering...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Why to such an extent...?

As she voiced her questions so purely and plainly,
she didn't seem to have any ulterior motives.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm, that is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because I want to make my dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...A 'dream'...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, the way I am right now is no good at all, so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm gonna run a ton like this,
and get stronger and stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to get a little bit closer to becoming the 'Number One Umamusume in Japan' every single day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...That's kind of how it feels, but...
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I was just a little surprised.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Piles of tires... early morning runs... evening side-by-side sprints... desperately chasing after—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (――All of it, for the sake of the "dream"...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...Is everyone like that...?)
Afterward, I persuaded the exhausted Special Week and sent her back to the dorm before sunset.

—A few days later. A mock race was held on campus
to improve everyone's skills.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

True to form, Silence Suzuka brilliantly seized 1st place.
However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I... couldn't catch up again...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"This won't do at all...!
Someone like me... someone like me is just...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, uuuuugh!

There had been Umamusume in the past who
shed tears, unable to hold a candle to Silence Suzuka.
Until now, she hadn't paid it any mind—in fact, she hadn't even noticed, but...
At this point, a change seemed to be taking place inside Silence Suzuka.
